newsitem.title: GERMANY: NordLB says sees 1997 profits at year-ago level.
newsitem.headline: NordLB says sees 1997 profits at year-ago level.

text.p: Norddeutsche Landesbank (NordLB), a publicly-owned German regional bank, said on Monday it expected its profit before risk provisions this year to more or less equal the 1996 level.

The bank, which is in negotiations to merge with Bankgesellschaft Berlin, reported profits before risk provisions of 842.8 million marks for 1996, up 4.9 percent, while net profit rose 23.4 percent to 185.4 million marks.
NordLB also said its first quarter profit before risk provisions rose 12.2 percent to 211.9 million marks.
